text:
nate: Putting a hold on the release window. Staging CI failing on artifact fetch - deploy-bot returns 403 for wheel package.
shay: Can you paste the runner logs?
nate: logs:
```
[runner] curl -fS -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" https://artifacts.internal/wheels/app-1.5.0.whl -> 403 Forbidden
[runner] retry 1/3 -> 403
[runner] pytest tests/integration/test_signup.py::test_signup_flow -> ERROR fixture port already in use
```
deploy-bot: promote paused: artifact-fetch-error code=403 attempts=3. Auto-promote suspended.
ops: We rotated the deploy key earlier and forgot to update the staging runner secret; fixing now.
maria: Recommend pin to last-known-good digest (sha256:1122aabb) while we fix auth. Pin reduces blast radius if migration isn't compatible.
shay: Agree. Nate, can you suspend auto-promote and flip routing to the pinned digest?
nate: Done: `/deploybot suspend R-2026-03-21-9` and routing flipped to sha256:1122aabb for 40m. Drafting a short note for #release-announcements.
ops: Staging runner secret updated. Retrying artifact fetch.
ci-bot: artifact fetch retry -> 200 OK, sha256 matches (c0ffee11). Pre-promote smoke queued.
maria: Run a quick integration smoke on the fetched artifact before manual promote.
shay: Smoke passes locally, integration harness has one flaky DB collision but rerun passed.
deploy-bot: manual-promote request allowed by nate. To proceed run: `/deploybot promote --manual R-2026-03-21-9`.
nate: Executing manual promote now. Rolling update policy: canary 10% for 5m -> 50% for 10m -> 100%.
shay: I'll monitor metrics and rollback window. Maria, please open a follow-up ticket to add a CI preflight check validating runner token freshness to avoid future 403s.
maria: On it (ticket PLAT-1337).
ops: I'll add an alert to detect 403 spikes from artifact registry.
ci-bot: promote accepted. Rollout started.
nate: Thanks team, removing hold once rollout finishes. Posting announcement: "Short pause due to staging runner secret rotation; pinned previous digest during verification; manual promote completed after token patch; rollout in progress." :white_check_mark:
